before: When a peer typed inside a pending insertion and accepted only the piece before the typing, while another participant accepted the whole insertion they saw before the typing, the piece after the typing stayed pending, and text after the insertion could join it. A content control removed with its content let a peer's concurrent unwrap show that content again, and text a join moved out of a paragraph a peer deleted at the same time showed again. After concurrent edits left the body and a content control both listing one block, a move could address the wrong block, and removing the block from where it showed could show it inside the other parent. A caret beside a tab the user had just inserted got no anchor and could land at the start of the paragraph after a peer joined it. A replica that waited for a held-back update rebuilt the whole document on every update until the missing one arrived.
after: A decision records the characters it takes out of a revision in the docx-text-decisions-v1 map, and every replica reads those characters outside that revision, so a peer's concurrent decision on one piece cannot restore the rest; the decision also keeps the marker that ends the revision. Its undo withdraws the record. A removed content control records the text of the paragraphs inside it as deleted, and a join writes the paragraph it removes, so its text is marked as copies a concurrent delete hides. A block that two parents list counts only where it shows, and removing it from there removes the other listing. The caret is anchored again at a later remote change when its paragraph could not be anchored. A replica that waits for a held-back update tries one full rebuild per wait.
reason: The decision records are a new map at the document root that released readers do not read, so for the same shared state a released replica would show text as pending that this release shows as decided. Which characters a revision holds after concurrent decisions is a rule for resolving conflicting writes, so it rides the repairVersion 3 change that the pending format docx-collaboration:1.5.3.1 already introduces; replicas with repairVersion 2 refuse these rooms. The kept end markers, deletion records, child splices, and listing removals are ordinary writes that every replica of this format reads. The caret anchor and the rebuild during a wait are replica-local. sharedSchemaVersion does not change: no existing field changes meaning, and a room without decision records reads as before.
